items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S4770

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
authorizing the assessor of the town of Rockland to accept applications
for exemption from real property taxation from
the Roscoe-Rockland fire district

PURPOSE:
To allow the Board of Assessors of the Town of Rockland to accept an
application for tax exemption from the Roscoe-Rockland Fire District.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:
Authorizes the Board of Assessors of the Town of Rockland to accept an
application for tax exemption from the Roscoe-Rockland Fire District
notwithstanding that such application is otherwise untimely. For the
parcels identified as lots 33.-1-43.2, 33.-1-44 and 33.-1-45.

EXISTING LAW:
Does not allow the Board to accept an application for tax exemption
outside the statutorily prescribed dates.

JUSTIFICATION:
The Roscoe-Rockland Fire District acquired title with financial
capital assistance from the State of New York to certain real
property after taxable status date. The property is in the Town of
Rockland. The Fire District is rural and has a minimal real property
tax base. The purchase of the property was complicated by the delays
in receiving the capital grant of $600,000 which was provided in
Governor Paterson's 2009 budget. The tax bill they are liable for is
approximately $31,078. That $31,078 would be better spent on
firefighter equipment.

The Town of Rockland has provided a Resolution dated February 3, 2011
in support of this legislation.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
New Bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None.

LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
The total real property tax bill is approximately $31,078.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.

summary: Authorizes the town of Rockland to accept an application for real property tax exemption from the Roscoe-Rockland fire district.
